title: Kawacha language
description: Endangered Angan language of Papua New Guinea
extract: Kawatsa is a nearly extinct Angan language of Papua New Guinea. According to one source, an estimated 12 people are believed to speak the language. It is spoken in Katsiong village, Tsewi ward, Kome Rural LLG.
